synth.generator: two-state Markov dry/wet, amp~Exp(1), noise on active

decision.rule: GO iff agg_improvement >= 5% and top5_share < 50% on either pooled fallback-row population (real weather / synthetic)

meta.oracle_scale_def: train mean|x| over nonzero points, per channel/cell
meta.topdecile: future points above clean-context q90 (S5 definition)

judgment.rule: harmful/mitigates iff best agg improvement >= 5% on clamped rows
